newsitem.title: SYRIA: Egypt's Mubarak meets Assad in Damascus.
newsitem.headline: Egypt's Mubarak meets Assad in Damascus.

text.p: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak arrived in Damascus on Monday and held talks with President Hafez al-Assad on the latest developments of the Middle East peace process.
Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said Assad and top Syrian officials had welcomed Mubarak on arrival at Damascus airport on Monday morning.
Present at the welcoming ceremony were Vice-President Abdel-Halim Khaddam, Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi and other ministers, he said.
Mubarak has criticised the Israeli government of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for abandoning the basis on which the peace process was based, mainly the exchange of occupied Arab land for peace.
